entities.name: Scarwoods
entities.description: A large forest of Terisiare during the Dark Age on Dominaria, host to bandits, demons, goblins, hags and scavenger folk.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Spoke of the Scarwoods at the Conclave of Mages.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Told by Mairsil about the lands around the school.

events.summary: Mairsil told Jodah of the Scarwoods, comparing them to the smaller Tanglewoods.
events.quote: he compared their much more impressive size to the smaller yet deadly Tanglewoods

relations.note: Part of the continent during the Dark Age.
relations.quote: the Scarwoods were part of the continent of Terisiare during the Dark Age
